Definition: from G1537 and G5401; frightened out of one's wits:-- sore afraid, exceedingly fear.
BiblicalUsage: ékphobos is the word for sore afraid, exceedingly fear. In Mark 9:6, the text says "for they were sore afraid."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ékphobos as it stands: sore afraid, exceedingly fear.
RelatedTopics: Fear; Fear of God; God's Power
